name: OddiszCommons
author: Oddisz
description: Shared parts for Oddisz's mods. Keeps the colony changes of Omega Core Everywhere, Astral Ascension Renewed and Toolbox Economy Curves, which need it. Adds a Manage button to the campaign bottom bar where Oddisz's mods keep their own pages, shared with Project Arondight, Captain's Quarters and Liminal. Adds loading screen tips for the supported mods you have installed.
